LanguageData.MutationBlink.label: blink
LanguageData.MutationBlink.description: A deformation of an unknown origin in the body part is causing colonist to periodically shift in and out of existance, reappearing at a different location, uncontrollably.
LanguageData.MutationBlinkAimed.label: aimed blink
LanguageData.MutationBlinkAimed.description: A deformation of an unknown origin in the body part is allowing colonist to shift in and out of existance, reappearing at a desired location, at will.
LanguageData.MutationBlinkControlled.label: controllable blink
LanguageData.MutationBlinkControlled.description: A deformation of an unknown origin in the body part is allowing colonist to shift in and out of existance, reappearing at a different location, at will. Colonist is not able to control where he'll reappear.
